correction_1_the_flight_task_cannot_be_s.what_i_said_at_r144: 'First contact with a real app' implied the flight task was now being solved.
correction_1_the_flight_task_cannot_be_s.what_is_true: Alaska/index.html and AA/index.html contain ZERO references to flightSubmit, which is the only path to core.validateForm and therefore the only path to a reward. No flight episode can register a score in this tree. r144 demonstrated correct DOM state on an unseen app; it did not and could not demonstrate reward.
correction_1_the_flight_task_cannot_be_s.why_it_matters: r144 was the round whose whole purpose was to stop overstating. It overstated.

correction_2_the_readiness_check_was_rea.what_i_did: polled `!!WOB_TASK_READY` to decide the flight app was loaded
correction_2_the_readiness_check_was_rea.what_happened: it returned True at t+1s, t+3s and t+6s while the iframe's contentDocument did not exist and wrap.src was None
correction_2_the_readiness_check_was_rea.the_fault: WOB_TASK_READY is a page global that survives navigation; it was true because a PREVIOUS episode had set it. This is the same fault as the earlier submit() bug that read a reward from the episode before, and it was reintroduced.
correction_2_the_readiness_check_was_rea.the_rule: readiness must be a fact about the CURRENT document (an element that only this page can have), never a bare global that outlives a navigation.

regression_check_r143_to_r145.verdict: no net regression from the slot reader / FILL_FORM addition
regression_check_r143_to_r145.the_uncomfortable_part: net +1 episode is inside the noise of 5 tasks moving. Two tasks each gained 3, three lost 1-2. The headline did not change; the per-task ledger shows five tasks changed. A single total would have reported 'no change' for a round in which five behaviours moved.
regression_check_r143_to_r145.instability: 7 of 38 valid tasks are non-deterministic across 5 repetitions (up from 3 two rounds ago). drag-cube went 5/5 -> 4/5 -> 3/5 -> 1/5 across four rounds without its code changing: the walk depends on where the cube happens to be rotating, and 50 pulses is not always enough.
